about_the_game:
Smart just got immersive!

Time to revisit your customers — this time in VR! Upgrade their homes with smart devices, motion sensors, digital switches, and colorful lights... all with your own hands!

Smart homes mean new challenges. Feel the thrill of wireless systems, troubleshoot smart gadgets right on your workbench, and rethink the way you wire — or un-wire — your environment.

6 brand-new smart devices, fresh workshop tasks, and a smarter way to play.
Get hands-on with the future of electricity — just make sure the power’s off before you dive in!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 6GB / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset
